name: shipment_id
definition: Snapshot metadata; exclude from the model matrix.

name: eta_id
definition: Snapshot metadata; exclude from the model matrix.

name: predicted_at
definition: Snapshot metadata; exclude from the model matrix.

name: service_mode
definition: Operational value from effective ServiceLevel.mode available as of predicted_at.

name: service_target_transit_hours
definition: Operational value from effective ServiceLevel.target_transit_hours available as of predicted_at.

name: service_reference_missing
definition: One when the associated source observation/value is missing; otherwise zero.

name: carrier_type
definition: Operational value from effective Carrier.carrier_type available as of predicted_at.

name: carrier_reference_missing
definition: One when the associated source observation/value is missing; otherwise zero.

name: carrier_historical_on_time_rate
source: Prior delivered events for this carrier with event_time and ingestion_time <= predicted_at; Beta-smoothed
definition: Smoothed reliability from other delivered events with event_time and ingestion_time at or before predicted_at.
missing_policy: prior rate used and carrier_history_missing flag set when no history

name: carrier_historical_delivery_count
source: Prior delivered events available by predicted_at, excluding current shipment
definition: Eligible prior carrier deliveries known by predicted_at, excluding the current shipment.

name: carrier_history_missing
definition: One when the associated source observation/value is missing; otherwise zero.

name: shipment_priority
definition: Operational value from Shipment.priority available as of predicted_at.

name: shipment_weight_kg
definition: Operational value from Shipment.weight_kg available as of predicted_at.

name: weight_missing
definition: One when the associated source observation/value is missing; otherwise zero.

name: journey_elapsed_minutes
definition: Minutes from shipment created_at to predicted_at.

name: planned_route_distance_km
definition: Operational value from ShipmentLeg + Route.distance_km available as of predicted_at.

name: planned_route_hours
definition: Operational value from ShipmentLeg + Route.planned_transit_hours available as of predicted_at.

name: planned_leg_count
definition: Operational value from ShipmentLeg.leg_number available as of predicted_at.

name: remaining_scheduled_leg_count
definition: Operational value from ShipmentLeg.planned_arrival_time available as of predicted_at.

name: remaining_scheduled_hours
definition: Sum of planned leg time remaining after predicted_at for legs whose planned arrival is later.

name: remaining_scheduled_distance_km
definition: Sum of route distance for legs whose planned arrival is later than predicted_at.

name: eligible_event_count
definition: Number of scans with event_time <= predicted_at AND ingestion_time <= predicted_at.

name: latest_event_type
definition: Operational value from latest eligible TrackingEvent.event_type available as of predicted_at.

name: latest_event_missing
definition: One when the associated source observation/value is missing; otherwise zero.

name: last_observed_state
source: state inferred from latest eligible TrackingEvent
definition: State inferred from the latest event eligible at predicted_at; never reads current lifecycle_state.

name: latest_event_age_minutes
definition: Minutes since the latest eligible event_time.

name: latest_event_leg_number
definition: Operational value from latest eligible event leg_id -> ShipmentLeg.leg_number available as of predicted_at.
missing_policy: null if event has no leg or event is absent

name: pickup_scan_seen
definition: One when the qualifying scan is available by predicted_at; otherwise zero.

name: minutes_since_pickup_scan
definition: Minutes since the latest eligible picked_up event_time.

name: weather_observation_count
definition: Realized weather observations observed and ingested by predicted_at.

name: active_weather_disruption_count
definition: Known realized weather windows active at predicted_at.

name: max_active_weather_severity
definition: Maximum severity among active realized weather observations available by predicted_at.

name: forecast_weather_count
source: WeatherForecast issued_at and ingestion_time <= predicted_at, valid interval overlaps route plan
definition: Forecasts issued and ingested by predicted_at whose validity intersects the remaining route.

name: max_forecast_weather_severity
definition: Maximum severity in eligible as-of forecasts; this is forecast, not realized weather.

name: forecast_precipitation_mm
definition: Mean precipitation forecast across eligible as-of forecast rows.

name: forecast_wind_speed_kph
definition: Mean wind speed forecast across eligible as-of forecast rows.

name: forecast_weather_missing
definition: One when the associated source observation/value is missing; otherwise zero.

name: weather_observation_missing
definition: One when the associated source observation/value is missing; otherwise zero.

name: queue_observation_count
source: FacilityQueue observed by predicted_at at shipment route facilities
definition: Count of facilities with at least one queue observation available by predicted_at.

name: max_observed_queue_length
definition: Maximum queue length from the latest queue observation observed and ingested by predicted_at per route facility.

name: mean_observed_wait_minutes
definition: Mean estimated, not actual, wait from queue observations available by predicted_at.

name: queue_wait_missing
definition: One when the associated source observation/value is missing; otherwise zero.

name: queue_observation_missing
definition: One when the associated source observation/value is missing; otherwise zero.

name: target_delivery_time
definition: Observed Shipment.actual_delivery_time; a target only, never a predictor.
missing_policy: null when shipment has no actual delivery

name: target_remaining_hours
definition: (actual_delivery_time - predicted_at) in hours; null unless delivery occurs after predicted_at.
missing_policy: null when target is absent or not after prediction

name: target_eligible
definition: One when actual_delivery_time is known and later than predicted_at; otherwise zero.
